title: 郵便とはがき
subject_en: Postal items, each ONE separate object or small scene centred in its cell: red post box, postcards, stamps, letters, a delivery scooter; generic design with no marks or logos, flat style Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ポスト・はがき・切手・配達など、郵便にまつわる素材12点です。年賀状や発送のお知らせの飾りに使えます。
items: a round red street post box
a blank postcard lying slightly tilted
a sheet of three small blank stamps with a perforated edge
a sealed envelope with a small heart-shaped seal
a red delivery scooter with a box on the back
a person in a cap delivering letters from a shoulder bag
a small mailbox on a gate post with letters sticking out
a bundle of postcards tied with a string
a person writing a postcard at a desk with a pen
a wrapped parcel tied with string
an envelope with a paper airplane next to it
a wall of mail sorting slots with letters in them
